title: Piston knuckles
paint:
The servo-fist without the gauntlet: a knuckle bar with a single piston strapped along the wrist. Pose: upright, three-quarter, filling about 75% of the canvas; no hand inside. Silhouette: a slab knuckle bar of four rings, one exposed piston running back to a wrist cuff with a small air bottle, no glove. Materials: dark steel, black rubber hose, scuffs. Accent: oxide red #CC2435 on the cuff.
At 32 px: one long piston behind the knuckle bar.
